text: えんりょ　なく　つりざおを　つかって　くれい！

structure.jp: つりざおを　つかって　くれい！

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て verb is a blunt 'do this for me'. The extra い is an old-man way of stretching it. つかってくれい = 'go on and use it'.

patterns.name: 〜なく
patterns.explanation: なく after a thing means 'without' it. えんりょなく = 'without holding back'.
